summary: ModuLink Inc., through its wholly owned subsidiary MITL, completed the acquisition of a 60% equity interest in ASA Robotics Limited from selling shareholder Wah Shing Lam. Consideration was 6,500 shares of Series A Convertible Preferred Stock valued at approximately HKD 5,000,000 (~USD 641,026). The transaction closed per the Share Purchase Agreement dated January 26, 2026. ASA Robotics becomes a majority-owned subsidiary, with the remaining 40% held by existing minority shareholders. The board of ASA Robotics will be reconstituted, and parties intend to enter an amended shareholders agreement. ModuLink expects to consolidate ASA Robotics' financials. Operations remain unchanged. Watch for post-closing integration and governance details.
